item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The report says AMLO’s security agenda promised prevention, pacification, and attention to social causes, but in practice security policy centered on militarization. By the end of 2023, the Guardia Nacional was practically composed of military personnel: 77.8% assigned to Sedena, 10.2% to Semar, and 10.2% to the GN. The report says AMLO-era reforms expanded the Armed Forces’ security powers and that the 2022 transfer of GN control to Sedena was declared unconstitutional by Mexico’s Supreme Court in 2023.","notes":["The supplied excerpt does not itself enumerate the formal agenda’s human-rights, reintegration, or institutional-strengthening elements."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E007","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"From 2019 to 2023, military security institutions received 72.2% of total security-institution spending; military spending rose 41.9% from 2018 while civil spending fell 50.8%. Federal transfers to states and municipalities for security programs fell 36%. The GN’s personnel increased 51.9% from 2019 to 2023; in practice, 94% of its members were military and 69% obtained the required police certificate.","notes":["The excerpt does not support a 34% decline in local security personnel or the absolute GN figure of 126,203 personnel."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Homicide deaths fell 17.3% between the comparison points, and reported crime per 100,000 inhabitants fell 12% from 2018 to 2023 but rose 15.9% from 2022 to 2023. Street robbery, extortion, vehicle theft, and household robbery declined from 2018 to 2023, while lesions rose 35.8%. The report notes that the homicide reduction coincided with increases in other offenses against life and personal liberty, raising doubts about whether homicides were being counted appropriately.","notes":["The excerpt does not state the proposed 59.5% and 104.5% increases for the other offense categories."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E010","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"From 2018 to 2023, personnel assigned to Mexico’s prosecutors’ offices fell 8%, FGR spending fell 28.4% through 2024, and prosecutorial administrative units fell 22.6%; pending investigations rose 60.3%. Illegal detentions remained above 20% at the state level on average and reached 11% federally on average across the reported period. Prison occupancy rose above capacity, prison complaints increased 866.4%, impunity remained above 90%, feminicide impunity rose 8.8 percentage points from 2021 to 2023, and the criminal-justice rule-of-law factor declined 5.2% from 2018 to 2024.","notes":["The excerpt specifies prosecutorial personnel, not all justice-system personnel."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E016","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E017","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E018","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":"The
